the total EU consumer food waste is 123 (min. 55–max. 190) kg/yr/capita and the associated water footprint is 321 (min. 147–max. 490) litre/yr/cap.
the EU consumer is responsible for the loss of significant quantities of water and nitrogen resources, and that the loss of these resources can be reduced by halving consumer food waste.
